college_name: The University of Texas at Austin
campus_notes: UT Austin does not publish room length x width anywhere. Official floor plans for every hall (https://housing.utexas.edu/housing/residence-halls/residence-hall-resources/essential-info-forms/residence-hall-floor-plans) are raster CAD drawings that label each individual room's exact square footage (no room-type labels and no dimension callouts); typical values from those drawings are recorded per hall below. Every residence hall room comes with, per resident: a movable lofted Twin XL (36" x 80") bed, desk, desk chair, small under-bed dresser with cabinet, and bookshelf, plus one MicroFridge/microwave per room, trash and recycling bins, and corkboard(s); no furniture dimensions are published. Beds loft/bunk in most halls ('all furniture is moveable'). Full loft beds (5 settings, middle = 45" to mattress top) appear in Blanton, Brackenridge, Duren, Jester, Kinsolving, Moore-Hill and Roberts; junior lofts (3 settings, 12"-45") in Andrews, Blanton, Carothers, Kinsolving and San Jacinto. All halls have AC and heat. Rates shown are per-person 2026-27 full academic year (room portion only, meal plan separate for halls; Jester/Duren/San Jacinto style rates include different bath configs). Many Jester rooms and renovated Kinsolving rooms have an in-room sink. Whitis Court closed for redevelopment (new ~1,000-bed hall opens 2027).
